text:
claire (finance): Quick heads-up: we're shipping a small set of billing changes on 2026-06-01. No pricing increases — operational clarity and a customer-friendly overage policy.

diego (revops): TL;DR: 1) Free trial credits window for new signups reduced from 90d to 60d (grandfathering window for existing trials). 2) Invoice line item refinement: `Free credits applied` will be listed separately in the pre-tax section. 3) Overage smoothing: micro-overages under $10 will be auto-credited to the next invoice (one-time, per-account). 4) Soft-burst policy for free tier keys (gentle 429s for sustained excess).

anya (legal): Confirmed wording okay; we added a short disclosure about grandfathering and the micro-overage cap in the customer email.

claire (finance): Example invoice snippet we'll show customers:```
Invoice: INV-2026-0312
Date: 2026-06-02
---
Usage (tokens): $132.40
Free credits applied: -$40.00
Net usage: $92.40
Micro overage credit (applied): -$8.00
Tax: $6.15
Total due: $90.55
```

matt (eng): On the API side: no change to billing endpoints, but the billing webhook will include new fields `free_credits_applied`, `micro_overage_credit`, and `trial_grace_end`. We'll publish the updated webhook spec on the docs page.

support-bot: Billing webhook spec v2 deployed to staging (auto).

diego (revops): Operational notes: micro-overage credits only apply when the account does not have an active billing dispute and is not delinquent. Also limited to once per billing period. We added `overage_waived:true|false` to the export CSV for reconciliation.

anya (legal): Also flagged region-specific tax treatment; finance, please coordinate with local tax advisors before customer comms if you have EU/UK customers with specific VAT wording.

claire (finance): Customer impact: existing trials created before 2026-06-01 keep the 90d window for 30 days after rollout. New trials from 2026-06-01 onward will get 60d. We'll include a migration FAQ and a short how-to for customers who want to apply for an extension.

matt (eng): Rate-limit behavior: free-tier keys get a soft-burst cushion (up to current peak for 2 minutes). If sustained >quota, API returns 429 with:```json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "type": "soft_burst",
  "retry_after": 45
}
```
We'll add retry/backoff guidance to SDKs and the status page.

diego (revops): Announcements plan: 1) internal all-hands note, 2) customer email (marketing+sales approved copy), 3) in-console banner 72h before change, 4) changelog and docs update. Draft customer email available here: <https://internal.redwood/comm/billing/june-2026-digest>.

claire (finance): Data team, note for exports: add `free_credits_applied`, `micro_overage_credit`, `trial_grace_end`, and `overage_waived` columns to the billing CSV. We'll ramp the webhook topic `billing.invoice.v3`.

matt (eng): We'll enable the webhook in staging 2026-05-10 and rollout to prod 2026-05-20. Please surface any integration blockers.

diego (revops): Support playbook attached in the handbook: <https://internal.redwood/handbooks/billing/micro-overage-playbook>. CS, please review and lmk if anything missing.

support-bot: Playbook link updated and assigned to #customer-success (auto).

claire (finance): If no blocking feedback by EOD next Tue, we'll schedule the public announcement. Thanks all. Please react with :white_check_mark: when reviewed.

diego (revops): :white_check_mark:
